lines.zh: 我在树枝上一步一步挪。
lines.en: I creep along the branch, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的爪垫贴着树皮，很稳。
lines.en: My pads grip the bark firmly.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树跳到下一棵。
lines.en: I leap from this tree to the next.

lines.zh: 夜里我的眼睛大得吓人。
lines.en: My eyes look huge at night.

lines.zh: 我顺着树干倒着爬下去。
lines.en: I climb down the trunk headfirst.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷着枝条，像第五只手。
lines.en: My tail curls the branch like a fifth hand.

lines.zh: 我踩过苔藓，脚下滑了一下。
lines.en: I slip a little on the moss.
I skirt that sweet berry bush.

lines.zh: 我贴着树皮，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the bark and stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我用前爪探了探下一根枝。
lines.en: I test the next branch with a forepaw.
I climb up along the vine.

lines.zh: 我从这个枝头滑到那个枝头。
lines.en: I glide from this branch to that.
I curl up like a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里有没有危险。
lines.en: I listen for danger in the wood.
I scratch my chin with a hind paw.

lines.zh: 我在枝头理毛，等夜色更深。
lines.en: I groom on the branch, waiting for deeper night.
I groom my tail.

lines.zh: 我被驯服以后会跟着你。
lines.en: Once tamed, I'll follow you.
Before taming, I avoid people.
I sit up and look into the distance.
Sweet berry bushes don't prick me.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，爪都张开。
lines.en: I stretch, spreading every claw.
I crouch and wait for you to approach.
My fur goes grey in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 翼膜一张，我跳到你肩上。
lines.en: Membrane spread, I leap to your shoulder.
Did you see me when you looked up?
I'm on the branch right above you.
Are you reaching out? I'm a little scared.

lines.zh: 你的手掌比我的背还大。
lines.en: Your palm is bigger than my back.
I don't bite — except nuts.
I sit up and meet your eyes.
Move suddenly and I'll glide away.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛能在黑里看清你。
lines.en: My eyes can see you in the dark.
You smell of berries.
You're close; I hardly dare move.

lines.zh: 我的手心在发汗，虽然没人看得见。
lines.en: My palms sweat, though no one can tell.

lines.zh: 我转了转头，确认你没恶意。
lines.en: I tilt my head to check you mean no harm.
Don't stand so straight. It's frightening.
I cling to the bark and peek at you.
Want to hold me? Sit down first.

lines.zh: 我尾巴竖起来了，那是好奇。
lines.en: My tail is up. That means curiosity.
I glide from the treetop onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才敢眨眼。
lines.en: I watch you a long while before I blink.
I jerk, fur standing on end.
I retreat behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我从枝上滑偏，撞了树干。
lines.en: My glide went wide and I hit the trunk.
I curl into the tree hollow and freeze.
I cradle my own paw.
I'm this small. You hit too hard.
I climb the branch slowly.

lines.zh: 我的滑膜破了一角，好疼。
lines.en: A corner of my gliding membrane is torn.
That thing in your hand. I want it.
Hold still and I'll come onto your hand.
This tastes better than bark.
I hug it and won't let go.
One more and I'll stay.
I eat ferociously.
I crouch in your palm and eat.
Don't move your fingers; you startled me.
I stuff the food into my cheeks.

lines.zh: 我吃一口，抬头看你一眼。
lines.en: A bite, then a glance up at you.

lines.zh: 你的袖子挡着我，我绕一下。
lines.en: Your sleeve is in the way; I'll go around.
Flatten your palm and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边发出小小的声。
lines.en: I make tiny noises while eating.

lines.zh: 你的食物比林子里的甜。
lines.en: Your food is sweeter than the forest's.
Touch me and I glide away at once.
I spring from your shoulder to the tree.
Don't grab me with your whole hand.
My bones are thin. Easy.

lines.zh: 你吓到我了，我缩成一团。
lines.en: You startled me; I curl into a ball.
My gliding membrane brushes your arm.

lines.zh: 我撞到你手指，滑了一下。
lines.en: I bump your finger and slip.

lines.zh: 你踩到我旁边的叶子，很响。
lines.en: You stepped on leaves beside me. Very loud.
I've climbed onto your sleeve.
After the bump, I shake out my fur.

lines.zh: 另一只也在这片林子里。
lines.en: Another one lives in this wood too.
We find each other by calls.
It glides over from the far tree.
Nest-mates sleep in a heap.
We split one fruit between us.
It eats first; I watch beside it.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我们各自回去。
lines.en: Dawn comes; we head to our own nests.
Tomorrow night, the same tree.
I hug it; it's bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 是颗甜浆果，我塞进颊袋。
lines.en: A sweet berry; I stuff it in my cheek pouch.
This pearl is slippery.
I gnaw once. It won't give.
What falls, I take.
I drag it up the tree, struggling.
Will this trade for what's in your hand?
I hide it under the bark.
Done, I hold it to my chest.
I prick my ears. I heard it.
That's not food. That's a threat.
I'm about to scream. Listen.
Something is watching my master.

lines.zh: 我从树上滑下去，引开它。
lines.en: I glide down to draw it away.
I hide in the leaves and watch.
There's more than one shadow.
I want to get back to my nest.

lines.zh: 它还在附近，我不敢下来。
lines.en: It's still near; I won't come down.
I'm up the tree, above it.
Its smell is getting closer.
If I'm still, it won't find me.

lines.zh: 我叫过了，主人该听见了。
lines.en: I've screamed; my master should hear.
I back along the branch.
Its voice is low. Dangerous.

lines.zh: 我把毛竖起来，显得大一点。
lines.en: I puff my fur to look bigger.
When it leaves, I'll come down.
I lunge and claw once.
I bite its ear.
I'm guarding my master. I won't hide.
I put everything into that.
I'm thrown off, and climb back.
I charge, screaming.
My tail whips its face.
I only want to drive it off.

lines.zh: 林子里多了一个小影子。
lines.en: One more small shadow in the wood.
Night is right. Out I come.
A leaf moves. It's me.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，开始找吃的。
lines.en: I lick my paws and start foraging.
This wood is very quiet.
Something sweet, over there.
I climb the bark to a high spot.

lines.zh: 从树梢滑下来，正好落在你面前。
lines.en: I glided down from the treetops and landed right in front of you.

lines.zh: 火苗溅到我，毛焦了一片。
lines.en: A spark catches me; a patch of fur singes.

lines.zh: 摔下来那下，我半天没动。
lines.en: After the fall, I don't move for a while.

lines.zh: 水把我打湿了，我拼命扑。
lines.en: Water soaks me; I flail.

lines.zh: 响声把我震得从树上掉下去。
lines.en: The bang knocks me off the branch.

lines.zh: 一支小箭擦过我的耳朵。
lines.en: A small arrow grazes my ear.
The light blinds me.
Hungry enough to gnaw bark.

lines.zh: 雷声吓得我抱紧了树枝。
lines.en: Thunder scares me into clutching the branch.
I keep sliding down.
